文档用途
本文档梳理飞虎队1945全部 12 个关卡所需的地面作战单位、水面作战单位和剧情场景素材（敌方阵地、指挥所、车队、火车、民居等），分类列出后供外包团队按需制作。每个素材条目标注了历史原型、出现关卡和当前实装状态（已有/新增/更新），便于排期。

目录

  1. 关卡总览与剧情背景

  3. 水面作战单位清单

01关卡总览与剧情背景

飞虎队1945 共 12 个关卡（10 常规 + 2 隐藏），覆盖 1941-1945 年飞虎队/第十四航空队在中缅印战区的主要战役。每个关卡的地理位置和剧情决定了需要哪些地面/水面单位及场景素材。

关卡名称历史事件地理位置BossBoss类型
L01昆明初战1941.12.20 昆明首捷昆明巫家坝机场/滇池Ki-48 编队空中
L02仰光空战1941.12.23-25 仰光防卫缅甸仰光（大金塔/港口/机场）天龙号轻巡水面
L03怒江惠通桥1942.5 炸桥阻敌怒江峡谷/惠通桥坂口装甲支队地面
L04新竹奇袭1943.11.25 跨海突袭遂川→台湾海峡→新竹机场妙高号重巡水面
L05衡阳保卫战1944.6-8 衡阳死守衡阳城区废墟/湘江筑垒要塞群地面
L06轰炸宝庆1944 宝庆补给中心宝庆铁路枢纽/仓库区弹药库综合体地面

L08白螺矶突袭1943-44 汉口白螺矶长江/白螺矶机场最上号重巡+塔台水面+地面
L09桂柳空中绞杀1944.8-11 桂林柳州桂林/柳州喀斯特峰林Ki-45 屠龙重战空中

H1驼峰绝径1942-45 喜马拉雅空运喜马拉雅雪山/峡谷精英 Ki-44环境

05各关卡素材需求明细

以下按关卡逐一列出所需的地面单位、水面单位和场景素材。每个关卡以剧情需求为核心，说明各类素材的用途。

L01 昆明初战 空中拦截 📍 昆明巫家坝机场 / 滇池

1941年12月20日，日军10架九七式重轰炸机空袭昆明，AVG P-40首战击落9架零损失。本关以空战为主，地面元素较少，主要为昆明城郊和滇池景观。

地面单位

G-10 防空炮
日军机场防空炮（少量）
E-30 中国民居
昆明城郊民居背景

水面单位

— 无
本关无水面作战单位

场景素材

E-42 机场跑道
巫家坝机场（盟军基地）
E-36 农田/水田
昆明郊外农田
L02 仰光空战 水面 Boss 📍 缅甸仰光（大金塔/港口/机场）

1941年12月23-25日，日军大规模空袭仰光，AVG与英军共同防卫。仰光港内停泊日军舰艇和运输船，大金塔为地标。天龙号轻巡洋舰从伊洛瓦底江入海口驶入，作为本关 Boss。

地面单位

G-10 防空炮
港口和机场防空火力
G-20 混凝土碉堡
港口防御工事

L03 怒江惠通桥 地面 Boss 📍 怒江峡谷 / 惠通桥

1942年5月5日，惠通桥已被我方炸毁。日军坂口支队工兵在怒江上同时搭建三处浮桥（完成度30%/50%/70%），每处浮桥附近均有密集防空炮台和装甲车辆掩护。任务：摧毁全部三处浮桥，阻止日军渡江。东岸集结的坂口装甲车队（5辆编组）为Boss。峡谷两侧峭壁为可撞毁障碍。

1944年9月，第14航空队侦察机在宝庆以东永丰铁路枢纽发现日军九四式装甲列车"铁龙"号。该列车从衡阳沿粤汉铁路南下，经永丰支线进入宝庆地区，为日军重型后勤基地运送弹药和油料。情报显示列车搭载实验性重型坦克及大量军需物资。任务：先炸油库瘫痪补给，再沿铁轨追击装甲列车，逐节摧毁20个炮台。车头逃逸倒计时30秒。

07AI 生图提示词模板

7.1地面单位通用模板

地面单位通用模板 Top-down orthographic view (90° vertical, zero perspective) of WWII Japanese [UNIT NAME] ([DESIGNATION]), viewed from directly above. [COLOR SCHEME] military camouflage with weathering and dust. [KEY FEATURES visible from top]. Cast shadow on ground (offset slightly to one side, soft edge). Hand-painted cel-shaded game sprite, metallic/wood textures with panel lines and rivets, classic arcade vertical scrolling shooter art style (like Strikers 1945 / Raiden), [CANVAS SIZE] pixel canvas with unit centered at [SPRITE SIZE] pixels, PNG transparent background, NO water reflection.

7.2水面单位通用模板

水面单位通用模板 Top-down orthographic view (90° vertical, zero perspective) of WWII Japanese [SHIP NAME] ([DESIGNATION]), viewed from directly above, floating on water. [COLOR SCHEME] naval gray hull with deck details. [KEY FEATURES visible from top: turrets, masts, funnels, superstructure]. NO wake/foam trail (wake is generated by game engine particles, do NOT bake into sprite). Waterline visible as subtle darker band along hull edge. Hand-painted cel-shaded game sprite, metallic hull with rust streaks and weathering, classic arcade vertical scrolling shooter art style (like Strikers 1945 / Raiden), [CANVAS SIZE] pixel canvas with ship centered at [SPRITE SIZE] pixels, PNG transparent background.

7.3场景素材通用模板

场景素材通用模板 Top-down orthographic view (90° vertical, zero perspective) of [BUILDING/STRUCTURE NAME], viewed from directly above. [ERA AND REGION] architecture style. [MATERIAL AND COLOR]. [KEY FEATURES visible from top: roof shape, courtyard, surrounding walls]. Cast shadow on ground (offset slightly, soft edge) for depth. Hand-painted cel-shaded game sprite, [TEXTURE: tile/wood/concrete/etc.] with weathering, classic arcade vertical scrolling shooter art style (like Strikers 1945 / Raiden), [CANVAS SIZE] pixel canvas, PNG transparent background.

7.4具体示例提示词

九七式中战车（G-01）

Top-down orthographic view (90° vertical, zero perspective) of WWII Japanese Type 97 Chi-Ha medium tank, viewed from directly above. Dark green and brown camouflage with dust weathering. Asymmetrical turret offset to the right of hull center, 57mm gun barrel pointing forward, four road wheels per side, rear engine deck visible. Cast shadow on ground (offset to lower-right, soft edge). Hand-painted cel-shaded game sprite, metallic armor with rivets and panel lines, classic arcade vertical scrolling shooter art style, 96x96 pixel canvas with tank centered at 60x36 pixels, PNG transparent background, NO water reflection.

天龙号轻巡（N-30，Boss级）

Top-down orthographic view (90° vertical, zero perspective) of WWII Japanese Tenryu-class light cruiser, viewed from directly above, floating on water. Naval gray hull with wooden deck details. Two twin 14cm gun turrets (one forward, one aft), tripod mast, three funnels side by side, torpedo launchers amidships. NO wake/foam trail. Waterline visible as subtle darker band along hull edge. Hand-painted cel-shaded game sprite, metallic hull with rust streaks, classic arcade vertical scrolling shooter art style, 256x128 pixel canvas with ship centered at 160x48 pixels, PNG transparent background.

惠通桥（E-40）

Top-down orthographic view (90° vertical, zero perspective) of WWII era Salween River suspension bridge (Huitong Bridge), viewed from directly above. Steel cable suspension bridge spanning a river gorge, wooden plank deck, two stone pylons at each end, steel cables visible from top as thin lines. Weathered brown and gray metal. Cast shadow on water surface (soft edge). Hand-painted cel-shaded game sprite, weathered steel and wood textures, classic arcade vertical scrolling shooter art style, 192x96 pixel canvas with bridge centered at 160x48 pixels, PNG transparent background.

九五式重型坦克（G-50，三炮塔）

Top-down orthographic view (90° vertical, zero perspective) of WWII Japanese Type 95 Heavy Tank, viewed from directly above. Dark olive green (#4A5548) with subtle rust and dust weathering. Distinctive triple-turret layout: one large central main turret (cylindrical with conical cupola) offset slightly forward, two smaller secondary turrets at diagonal corners (front-left and rear-right). Main 70mm gun barrel projecting forward, 37mm gun on front turret. Riveted armor surface visible. Rhomboid hull widest at center, narrowing at bow and stern. Long tracks visible at sides. Cast shadow on ground (offset to lower-right, soft edge). Hand-painted cel-shaded game sprite, metallic armor with rivets and panel lines, classic arcade vertical scrolling shooter art style, 56x28 pixel canvas with tank centered, PNG transparent background.

九四式装甲列车 1号 装甲火车头（G-40a，Boss最终阶段）

Top-down orthographic view (90° vertical, zero perspective) of WWII Japanese Type 94 Armored Train locomotive (car #1), viewed from directly above along vertical railroad tracks. Armored steam locomotive with thick riveted armor plates, dark gray-green color. Two main gun turrets (105mm) mounted on top side-by-side, two smaller machine gun turrets at front edge. Smokestack visible between turrets. Rail wheels visible at bottom. Heavy weathering, soot stains around smokestack. Cast shadow on ground (offset to lower-right, soft edge). Hand-painted cel-shaded game sprite, metallic armor with rivets, classic arcade vertical scrolling shooter art style, 80x44 pixel canvas, PNG transparent background, railroad tracks NOT included (separate asset).

九四式装甲列车 2号 重型火力车（G-40b，高速导弹车厢）

Top-down orthographic view (90° vertical, zero perspective) of WWII Japanese armored train missile car (car #2), viewed from directly above along vertical railroad tracks. Armored boxcar with three weapon mounts: one large missile launcher in center (elevated, with launch rail visible), two anti-aircraft gun turrets on left and right sides (upper and lower). Dark gray-green riveted armor. Rail wheels visible at bottom. Cast shadow on ground. Hand-painted cel-shaded game sprite, metallic armor with rivets, classic arcade vertical scrolling shooter art style, 72x44 pixel canvas, PNG transparent background.

九四式装甲列车 8号 警戒车厢（G-40h，热身阶段）

Top-down orthographic view (90° vertical, zero perspective) of WWII Japanese Type 94 Armored Train guard car (car #8, tail end), viewed from directly above along vertical railroad tracks. Armored flatcar with searchlight housing at center (armored shutter closed), two machine gun turrets at rear-left and rear-right corners (270° traverse). Railroad track repair materials (railroad ties and rails) stacked at sides. Dark gray-green riveted armor. Rail wheels visible at bottom. Cast shadow on ground. Hand-painted cel-shaded game sprite, metallic armor with rivets, classic arcade vertical scrolling shooter art style, 64x40 pixel canvas, PNG transparent background.

浮桥 半搭建（E-46，怒江关核心目标）

Top-down orthographic view (90° vertical, zero perspective) of WWII era Japanese military pontoon bridge half-constructed across a river, viewed from directly above. Wooden planks and oil barrels lashed together forming partial bridge deck, rope lines connecting to both riverbanks. Only 50% of bridge width complete — right half shows assembled planks, left half shows scattered barrels and bare rope lines. Brown weathered wood, rusted barrels. Water visible between planks. Hand-painted cel-shaded game sprite, wood and metal textures, classic arcade vertical scrolling shooter art style, 96x48 pixel canvas with bridge centered, PNG transparent background.

中国民居（E-30）

Top-down orthographic view (90° vertical, zero perspective) of 1940s rural Chinese house in Yunnan/Hunan province, viewed from directly above. Gray tile roof sloped on four sides, white-washed walls visible at edges, small courtyard. Weathered and aged appearance. Cast shadow on ground (offset to lower-right, soft edge). Hand-painted cel-shaded game sprite, tile and plaster textures, classic arcade vertical scrolling shooter art style, 96x96 pixel canvas with house centered at 56x48 pixels, PNG transparent background.
文档结束 — 下一步讨论
本清单梳理了 12 个关卡的地面/水面作战单位和剧情场景素材需求，共 94 个素材条目（8 已有 + 74 新增 + 12 更新）。已确认：美术风格参照 iFighter 2（高清2D数字拼贴），五套色调体系，全纵向滚动，怒江浮桥剧情+装甲车队Boss，宝庆九四式装甲列车8节Boss（20炮台逐个摧毁）。
